name: Natural Attunement
source:
Natural Attunement is a laid back furry VN, set in an alternate version of earth where Exolae are the dominant species.

River is an artic fox with illusion magic that has betrayed them, leaving them with issues for their whole life. Eventually, they found a place to belong, with others like them. During the week, you'll get to know a diverse array of characters, and get closer to one during a group trip, helping them come to terms with whatever troubles them.

[From [url=https://rngkatt.itch.io/natural-attunement]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Natural Attunement》是一部节奏轻松的兽人视觉小说，背景是另一个版本的地球，Exolae是这个世界的主导物种。

River是一只拥有幻术的北极狐，但这份魔法却背叛了自己，带来伴随一生的困扰。最终，River在与自己相似的人们身边找到了归属。在这一周里，你将认识形形色色的角色，并在一次集体旅行中与其中一人更加亲近，帮助对方面对心中的烦恼。

[摘自[url=https://rngkatt.itch.io/natural-attunement]itch.io[/url]]
